changed.what: Wire names counted correctly (thirteen) with the five fork-label spellings; ForkRequest gains `reuse` (the explicit graft request behind FROB-REF-582); ChildKey hashes the full perturbation record; dep BD-003 (xtask check-layers used in acceptance).

Rules added for `contact-law` and for unsampled `scene-optics`; forced_by of sensor-link and estimator stated; the fixed forced_by order now covers every history field and is restricted to fields the checkpoint holds; FROB-REF-582 tied to the `reuse` list; tests for the graft with its tick-0 control, the contact law, optics and the order.

Ring arithmetic corrected: 20 snapshots reach back 1.7 s (ticks 415 to 510), lead 2 s is 0.3 s before the oldest snapshot, serving it needs a 2.3 s ring (2.2 s still falls short); dep BD-209 (pins and tombstones used by step 8).

Child key includes the perturbation record itself, so distinct perturbations never share an address; duplicate-children rule rewritten so that one key per specification and `children_identical` by experiment content no longer contradict each other; tests added.

Information restore calls N20ax-01's `retime_in_flight` and `reinit_state` and states the default-source table N20ax-01 assigns here (RescaleToLaw, Keep, FromTruth; quantization row added); FROB-REF-441 propagated with no child started; tests for 441, rescale and FromTruth.
The 447 non-placebo children are specified as pairwise-distinct change sets (72 singles, then cross-row pairs) and the 512 child keys are checked distinct, so the batch really holds 512 children.

Row S5 uses the depth camera (episode Q has no lidar); information rows' forcing fields made consistent with the classifier's dependency sets; K3 carries its labels; S3 and S4 lists stated; exact ordered lists defined as the classifier's fixed order restricted to the pinned manifest; G1 written with `--reuse` and its tick-0 control.

Step 2 exit code follows BD-205's rule and admits `same-precision` and `unresolved`; the 100 planted sets and 100 grafts are actually run, so `planted_sets_correct` and `graft_refused` are measured; graft command written with `--reuse` plus its tick-0 control.

`--reuse <checkpoint field>` added to the verb (the way a graft is requested and FROB-REF-582 reached); unit tests for the graft, the stripped-queue refusal, idempotency, and concrete inputs for source_row_untouched and cancel_returns_slots.
Defaults table gains the test level alpha = 1/20 and is declared open to later beads' constants (lane R0, rho0, growth bound, replicates; cross-check k), so the no-literal rule stays true.

Permutations drawn from the registered stream `autopsy-shapley` (row 21, `frob_core::streams::AUTOPSY_SHAPLEY`, entity the attribution identifier, tick the permutation index) instead of an unregistered `autopsy.shapley`.

Second-series fork count uses BD-279's trigger (coalitions that changed the outcome), so the count equals the forks run; the >12-factor trimming removed because BD-279 and N27b-12 refuse it upstream with FROB-REF-802 (`plan_coalitions` asserts m <= 12); tests `thirteen_factors_rejected` and `second_series_count_matches_run_layer`.

A/A controls made runnable: ten failing worlds whose adverse factor is left out of the declared list, none of 55 coalitions rescuing at planting (a world with no adverse factor does not fail and cannot be attributed); acceptance and test added.
The divergence block's end-to-end check moved to N27a-18's M3 script; the M2 script of N27a-09 cannot call the M3 `autopsy.attribute`.

Chaotic expectation made consistent with the keep rule (each case >= 0.3, mean over 50 in [0.45, 0.55]); five-iterate seeds keep a 1e-9 margin so rho0 = 0 is guaranteed; the standing-robot control is now a failing world (stance height under a declared torque cap) with the cap named but-for, since a passing world or a nothing-rescues world would not be a non-abstention control.
Deps BD-058 (the `regear` typed edit), BD-118 (per-design controller re-synthesis) and BD-159 (the CPU tier in f64), none of which was reachable.

Step 3 asserts exit 3 for the lone gear change (N27-REF convention, BD-279 all_refused_exit_3) and adds the variant with a runnable setpoint change that must exit 2 with `refused[0]`; consideration updated.

Second-series count uses 'changed the outcome'; A/A and standing-robot controls asserted as now planted; new divergence-block check against `frob telemetry divergence` with metrics `aa_named_nothing` and `divergence_block_agrees`; dep N27a-13.
The standing-robot control is a failing world whose declared torque cap must be named but-for with rho0 = 0, matching N27a-14; otherwise it would be an abstention, not a control.
The passing-world sample's stream is registered as an appended row `autopsy-rerun-sample` of registries/streams.toml (N35-23's owner-append rule); test covers it.

`verdict_from_records` fixed: at a = 3, b = 15 no bet can reach E = 20 in 60 pairs ((1 + 2/39 2/3)^60 = 19.1), so the confirmed case now uses a = 3, b = 30 and the old case asserts 'not confirmed' as the reachability limit.

`e_process_constant_ratio` fixed: ten pairs at d = 2 reach at most E = 1.64, so the ratio bound cannot fall below 1/3 there; the test now states the bet ceiling (61 pairs at d = 2, 12 at the extreme pair); the fixed-n paired-bound check is restated for an anytime-valid study.

Derived 689/137 counts worded with the run layer's 'changed the outcome' trigger; the script list now covers KA-670 (autopsy_attribute_planted.sh) and KA-679 (autopsy_refusals.sh), so every numbered row has a user-side script.

requests.what: Ring arithmetic near line 178: with 20 snapshots at ticks 415..510 the ring reaches back 1.7 s, not 1.8 s; the 2 s lead (tick 400) lies 0.3 s before the oldest snapshot, not 0.2 s; serving it from the ring needs a 2.3 s ring (23 snapshots, 400..510), because a 2.2 s ring's oldest snapshot is tick 405. N27a-03 now states this, and the two are meant to state it identically.

Step 7 ('state reuse requested'): use the flag BD-205 now defines, `frob run fork <C> --at <lip tick> --change 'model.wheel[front].radius := 75 mm' --reuse checkpoint.contact.memory`, so the graft is requested in the same way as in N27a-07 and N27a-08.

(1) The >12-factor FROB-REF-802 refusal has no repair route. BD-281 used to carry a top-12 trimming that contradicted this refusal, so it was removed there. Please add ranked repairs to the refusal so the feature is not lost: run the singles in groups of at most 12, then the pairs among the 12 factors with the largest single contrasts. (2) Tie 'the change set would reuse state it invalidates' (step e) to the `reuse` list of ForkRequest / `--reuse` of run.fork (N27a-01, BD-205).

notes: All 25 beads read in full against plan sections 27, 29 and Appendix I.12. The arithmetic was recomputed in scratch scripts: Fisher p-values 0.0152, 0.00237 and 0.176; e-process bounds; ring ticks; thermal and lip values. New deps were checked acyclic with graph_check. All touched files parse: front matter is JSON-valued, there are seven sections and three test subsections, and every dep and related key is in INDEX.tsv. The fixes come in three groups: (a) the graft is now an explicit `reuse` request, threaded through N27a-01, N27a-02, BD-205, N27a-07 and N27a-08; (b) planted controls that could not run as written are now runnable (N27a-12 A/A, N27a-14/BD-282 standing robot); (c) the e-process reachability arithmetic is fixed (BD-375, N27a-19).
